user_saw: Discord bot and persona replies displayed known aliases such as `@alice.` as literal text, so the intended recipient was not mentioned.
summary: The fix preserves sentence-ending periods by trying the longest known alias first and uses balanced URL boundaries to resolve mentions after Markdown links while preserving URL contents.
reasoning: The pre-fix resolver captured trailing periods in `[a-z0-9_.-]{2,32}` and looked up the entire captured handle, so an alias configured as `alice` did not match `alice.`. The July 1 snapshot already had both behaviors, and the available path history ends at a missing object before that snapshot, so I could not verify whether the defect shipped with alias resolution or a later change.
